text: DIAGNOSIS READY: DiGeorge Syndrome (22q11.2 deletion syndrome). The clinical presentation of a continuous heart murmur (likely a patent ductus arteriosus), bluish macules, cataracts, and failure to pass auditory screening, combined with a history of no prenatal care, is highly suggestive of this congenital disorder.
